
#v90Hero .v90-lede{font-size:clamp(16px,2vw,20px);line-height:1.55;color:#3c5548;max-width:560px;margin:0 0 24px}
#v90Hero .v90-primary{display:block;padding:15px 26px;min-height:54px;border:0;border-radius:13px;background:#1a5134;color:#fff;font-size:17px;font-weight:740;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 5px 13px #21463228}
#v90Hero .v90-primary:hover{background:#17452d}
#v90Hero .v90-status{font-size:13px;color:#52715d;margin:15px 0 21px;line-height:1.5}
#v90Hero .v90-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;border-top:1px solid #d6e0d6;padding-top:20px}
#v90Hero .v90-actions button,#v90SubjectChoices button{padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #bdcfbf;background:#fff;color:#244934;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer}
#v90Hero .v90-actions button:hover,#v90SubjectChoices button:hover{background:#e9f5e9}
#v90SubjectChoices{margin:18px 0 0;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px dashed #c6d6c6}
#v90SubjectChoices[hidden]{display:none!important}
#v90SubjectChoices p{font-size:14px;margin:0 0 12px;color:#445e4e}
#v90SubjectChoices button{margin:0 7px 9px 0}
#v90Panel[hidden]{display:none!important}
#v90Panel{position:fixed;z-index:500000;inset:0;background:#081e15ae;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding:12px;overflow:auto}
#v90Panel .v90-dialog{width:min(690px,100%);max-height:min(850px,95dvh);overflow:auto;background:#fffefb;border-radius:19px;padding:clamp(17px,3vw,28px);box-shadow:0 24px 70px #071d1599;color:#243f2e}
#v90Panel header,#v90Panel footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#v90Panel h2{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:27px;margin:0 0 12px;color:#183b2b}
#v90Panel h3{margin:0 0 7px;font-size:17px;color:#224731}
#v90Panel button{padding:9px 13px;border-radius:9px;background:#f0f5ef;border:1px solid #aec7b6;color:#254a35;cursor:pointer}
#v90Panel footer{border-top:1px solid #e2e9e0;padding-top:17px;margin-top:17px;justify-content:flex-start}
#v90Panel .v90-muted{color:#536759;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}
#v90Panel .v90-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:11px;margin:18px 0}
#v90Panel .v90-metric{padding:16px;border:1px solid #dae5db;border-radius:12px;background:#f9fbf7}
#v90Panel .v90-metric p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;margin:5px 0;color:#455b4a}
#v90Panel .v90-metric button{margin-top:10px}
#v90Panel .v90-empty{background:#f6f8f2;border-radius:12px;padding:20px;margin:18px 0}
.v90-lesson-link{margin:20px 0 8px;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #52745c;background:#e7f4e8;color:#1c5130;font-weight:650;cursor:pointer}
.v90-notice{position:fixed;z-index:500001;bottom:16px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);max-width:min(480px,calc(100vw - 32px));padding:14px 18px;background:#173d2d;color:white;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px #1e3a2a50}
#v35Portal.v52-night #v90Hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#193326,#214132);border-color:#547562;color:#eef9ec}
#v35Portal.v52-night #v90Hero h1{color:#eaf7e7}
#v35Portal.v52-night #v90Hero .v90-lede,#v35Portal.v52-night #v90Hero .v90-status,#v35Portal.v52-night #v90Hero .v90-eyebrow{color:#c7ddcb}
#v35Portal.v52-night #v90Hero .v90-actions button,#v35Portal.v52-night #v90SubjectChoices button{background:#294e38;color:#f0f8ee;border-color:#648570}
@media(max-width:500px){#v90Hero{margin:12px 4px 30px;padding:24px 19px}#v90Hero .v90-primary{width:100%}#v90Hero .v90-actions button{flex:1 1 auto}#v90Panel .v90-metrics{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

body.v90-onhome:not(.v90-explore) #v73launch{display:none!important}

#v90Panel .v90-file{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:9px;background:#f0f5ef;border:1px solid #aec7b6;color:#254a35;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer}
#v90Panel .v90-file input{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;opacity:0;cursor:pointer}

</style>
<style id="v101-shared-teaching-design">
/* One cohesive reading hierarchy for every guided/teacher lesson; existing course content remains intact. */
#v97Study{background:#fbfaf6;border:1px solid #d6e0d6;border-radius:20px;max-width:min(1200px,97vw)}
#v97Study .v97-top{background:#183d30;padding:17px 26px}
#v97Study .v97-content{grid-template-columns:minmax(195px,250px) minmax(0,1fr)}
#v97Study .v97-nav{background:#f0f4ed;border-color:#d5e0d7;padding:25px 15px}
#v97Study .v97-nav h3{margin-top:24px}
#v97Study .v97-navitem{display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative;gap:3px;padding:12px 13px;border:1px solid transparent;font-size:13px}
#v97Study .v97-navitem[aria-current=page]{border-color:#bfd4c3;background:#dceade}
#v97Study .v101-navnumber{font:750 10px system-ui;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#64816b}
#v97Study .v101-done{font-size:11px;color:#2c7350}
#v97Study .v101-side-note{font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:#60776a;margin:18px 8px}
#v97Study .v97-main{max-width:none;padding:0 0 50px;scroll-padding-top:72px;background:#fbfaf6}
#v97Study .v101-lead,#v97Study .v101-chapter,#v97Study .v101-lesson-footer{max-width:750px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;padding-left:clamp(22px,5vw,58px);padding-right:clamp(22px,5vw,58px)}
#v97Study .v101-lead{padding-top:42px;padding-bottom:25px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f7faf3 0%,#fbfaf6 100%)}
#v97Study .v101-lead h1{font-size:clamp(33px,3.6vw,48px);letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1.13;margin-top:16px;margin-bottom:16px}
#v97Study .v97-scene{font-size:clamp(17px,2vw,21px);max-width:660px;color:#3c5846;line-height:1.65}
#v97Study .v101-lesson-progress{height:4px;background:#e4ece1;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:25px}
#v97Study .v101-lesson-progress-fill{background:#2d7350;height:100%;transition:width .2s}
#v97Study .v101-outcome{background:#eaf2e9;border:1px solid #d3e1d3;border-radius:12px;margin-top:24px;padding:18px 21px}
#v97Study .v101-outcome-label{font:800 11px system-ui;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.11em;color:#316349}
#v97Study .v101-outcome p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.55;margin:8px 0 0;color:#1b4530}
#v97Study .v101-toc{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:4;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:#fcfcf9eb;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-top:1px solid #e4eae0;border-bottom:1px solid #dbe5db;padding:10px clamp(18px,5vw,46px)}
#v97Study .v101-toc a{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#29513d;border:1px solid #c7dacb;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 12px;text-decoration:none;background:white}
#v97Study .v101-toc a:hover{background:#e6f1e5}
#v97Study .v101-status{font:12px system-ui;color:#678273;margin-left:auto}
#v97Study .v101-chapter{padding-top:35px;padding-bottom:22px;scroll-margin-top:80px}
#v97Study .v101-section-eyebrow{font:800 11px system-ui;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#4d6c57;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
#v97Study .v101-section-eyebrow span{background:#1f563d;color:white;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;width:27px;height:27px;letter-spacing:0}
#v97Study .v101-chapter h2{font:700 clamp(25px,2.4vw,30px)/1.2 Georgia,serif;margin:14px 0 10px;color:#193f2f}
#v97Study .v101-teaching-intro{font-size:15px;color:#496353;margin-bottom:24px}
#v97Study .v101-teaching-steps{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:24px 0 0}
#v97Study .v101-teaching-steps li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:35px minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;border-bottom:1px solid #dbe6db;padding:16px 0;margin:0;line-height:1.7;font-size:16px}
#v97Study .v101-stepno{display:grid;place-items:center;background:#e3efe5;color:#2e6548;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:10px;font:800 14px system-ui}
#v97Study .v101-rule{margin-top:27px;padding:20px 23px;background:#f1ebde;border-left:4px solid #be9253;border-radius:12px}
#v97Study .v101-rule strong{font-size:13px;color:#694b2c}
#v97Study .v101-rule p{margin:8px 0 0;line-height:1.7}
#v97Study .v101-chapter-practice{background:#f3f8f0;border-block:1px solid #dce7d9;max-width:none}
#v97Study .v101-chapter-practice>*{max-width:700px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
#v97Study .v97-quiz{background:white;padding:24px;border-color:#c1d7c5;box-shadow:0 5px 18px #19372109}
#v97Study .v97-choices{gap:10px}
#v97Study .v97-choice{background:#fff;padding:15px 16px;font-size:15px;border-color:#b4c7b6}
#v97Study .v97-choice:not(:disabled):hover{border-color:#3b7953;background:#f1f7f0}
#v97Study .v101-why{font-size:17px;line-height:1.75}
#v97Study .v101-misconception{border:1px solid #d5d8cd;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;background:#faf5eb;margin-top:19px}
#v97Study .v101-misconception summary{font-weight:750;cursor:pointer;color:#655036}
#v97Study .v101-misconception p{font-size:15px}
#v97Study .v97-ask{margin-top:25px;padding-top:20px}
#v97Study .v97-ask summary{cursor:pointer;color:#204d36}
#v97Study .v101-assist-label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:750;margin:10px 0 6px}
#v97Study .v101-keyboard-wrap{padding:15px 19px 8px;background:#eef3ed;border-radius:14px;margin-top:25px;border:1px solid #cbdbce}
#v97Study .v101-keyboard-wrap h3{font:650 19px Georgia,serif}
#v97Study .v101-lesson-footer{padding-top:28px;padding-bottom:22px;display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#v97Study .v101-lesson-footer button{border:1px solid #235c40;background:#215b41;color:#fff;border-radius:9px;padding:11px 15px;font-weight:700}
#v97Study .v101-lesson-footer .v101-secondary{background:#fff;color:#24563e;border-color:#b6cfbd}
#v97Study .v101-lesson-footer button:disabled{opacity:.4}
#v97Study :is(button,a,summary,select,input):focus-visible,.guide-shell :is(button,a,input,select,textarea):focus-visible{outline:3px solid #cf9144!important;outline-offset:3px!important}
/* Large existing shared guided curriculum: readable information architecture without removing content. */
.guide-shell{--v101-line:#d4dfd4}
.guide-content.v101-reading{max-width:980px;background:#fcfbf7;border:1px solid #dbe4d9;border-radius:18px;padding:0 clamp(18px,3.6vw,35px) 30px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #10391d08}
.guide-content.v101-reading .kicker{margin-top:29px;font-size:11px}
.guide-content.v101-reading>h2{font-size:clamp(29px,3vw,39px);letter-spacing:-.018em;max-width:750px}
.guide-content.v101-reading>.statement{font-size:clamp(16px,1.5vw,19px);line-height:1.7;color:#335a45;max-width:740px}
.guide-content.v101-reading>.guide-card,.guide-content.v101-reading>.guide-quiz{margin-top:14px;border-radius:13px;padding:20px 23px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d5e2d7}
.guide-content.v101-reading>.guide-card.highlight{background:#eaf3e9;border-color:#c8ddce}
.guide-content.v101-reading>.guide-card h3{font:700 19px/1.4 Georgia,serif;color:#1b4630;margin:0 0 9px}
.guide-content.v101-reading>.guide-card p,.guide-content.v101-reading>.guide-card li{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.85;color:#294333}
.guide-content.v101-reading>.guide-quiz{background:#eef6ed;border-color:#c5dbc8;margin-top:25px}
.guide-content.v101-reading>.guide-quiz h3{font:700 21px Georgia,serif}
.v101-guided-tools{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;position:sticky;top:8px;z-index:10;background:#f5f9f2f0;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);padding:10px;margin:0 -12px 15px;border:1px solid #d1e1d2;border-radius:0 0 12px 12px}
.v101-guided-tools :is(a,button){text-decoration:none;font:700 12px system-ui;color:#245b3f;background:#fff;border:1px solid #c1d6c5;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 13px;cursor:pointer}
.v101-guided-tools :is(a,button):hover{background:#e5f0e4}
.v101-guided-tools button{margin-left:auto}
body.v101-focus-reading .guide-guide{display:block;max-width:960px;margin-inline:auto}
body.v101-focus-reading .guide-guide>.guide-topics{display:none}
body.v101-focus-reading .guide-content.v101-reading{margin-inline:auto}
.guide-content.v101-reading #v101GuidedPractice{scroll-margin-top:90px}
.guide-content.v101-reading #v101GuidedMain{scroll-margin-top:90px}
html[data-study-theme="dark"] #v97Study .v97-main,html[data-study-theme="dark"] #v97Study .v101-lead,html[data-study-theme="dark"] #v97Study .v101-toc,html[data-study-theme="dark"] #v97Study .v101-chapter-practice,html[data-study-theme="dark"] .guide-content.v101-reading{background:#1b2a22!important;color:#e7f3e8!important}
html[data-study-theme="dark"] #v97Study .v101-outcome,html[data-study-theme="dark"] #v97Study .v101-rule,html[data-study-theme="dark"] #v97Study .v101-misconception,html[data-study-theme="dark"] #v97Study .v101-quiz,html[data-study-theme="dark"] #v97Study .v97-nav,html[data-study-theme="dark"] #v97Study .v101-keyboard-wrap,html[data-study-theme="dark"] .guide-content.v101-reading>.guide-card,html[data-study-theme="dark"] .guide-content.v101-reading>.guide-quiz{background:#26392d!important;color:#e8f1e7!important;border-color:#55745e}
html[data-study-theme="dark"] #v97Study :is(.v101-lead h1,.v101-chapter h2,.v101-outcome p,.v97-scene,.v101-why,.v101-rule strong,.v101-rule p,.v97-quiz h3,.v101-misconception summary,.v97-navitem),html[data-study-theme="dark"] .guide-content.v101-reading :is(h2,h3,p,li){color:#e6f2e8!important}
html[data-study-theme="dark"] #v97Study .v101-toc a,html[data-study-theme="dark"] .v101-guided-tools :is(a,button){background:#2b4233;color:#e7f4e9;border-color:#618269}
html[data-study-theme="dark"] .v101-guided-tools{background:#213829}
@media(max-width:740px){#v97Study{max-width:100vw;border-radius:14px 14px 0 0}#v97Study .v97-content{display:block}#v97Study .v97-nav{display:grid;padding:9px 12px}#v97Study .v97-main{padding-bottom:40px}#v97Study .v101-lead{padding-top:25px}#v97Study .v101-toc{padding:10px 12px}#v97Study .v101-toc a{font-size:11px;padding:8px}#v97Study .v101-status{display:none}#v97Study .v101-chapter{padding-top:24px}#v97Study .v101-teaching-steps li{gap:10px}#v97Study .v101-lesson-footer{gap:7px}#v97Study .v101-lesson-footer button{flex:1 1 120px} .guide-content.v101-reading{padding:0 14px 25px}.v101-guided-tools{top:0;margin:0 -5px 14px;padding:8px 5px}.v101-guided-tools :is(a,button){font-size:11px;padding:8px 9px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#v97Study .v101-lesson-progress-fill{transition:none!important}}

 #v97Study .v97-nav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:10px 13px;max-height:none;overflow:visible}

28px));max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;border:1px solid #cbd6c6;border-radius:18px;padding:clamp(20px,4vw,34px);color:#20392f;background:#f7f6ef}#v102Session::backdrop{background:#173d3377}#v102Session header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;background:none;color:inherit;padding:0}#v102Session h2{font:400 34px/1.2 Georgia,serif;margin:0}#v102Session p{line-height:1.7}#v102Start{margin:0 0 20px}.v102-subjects{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.v102-subjects button{text-align:left!important;background:#e8efe2!important;color:#20392f!important;border-color:#bfceba!important}.v102-subjects span{display:block;font:400 13px/1.6 system-ui;margin-top:6px}.v102-file{display:block;font-size:13px}.v102-file input{display:block;max-width:100%;margin-top:7px}#v97Main textarea:focus-visible,#v102Session :focus-visible{outline:3px solid #b17b3e;outline-offset:3px}

</style><style id="merged-challenges-style">
#v103skillLauncher{position:fixed;left:17px;bottom:17px;z-index:99997;max-width:calc(100vw - 30px);background:#e7b975;color:#253d2b;border:2px solid #fcf0c9;border-radius:999px;padding:13px 18px;font:800 14px system-ui;box-shadow:0 4px 25px #1a342a44;cursor:pointer}
#v103skillMastery{padding:0;border:0;border-radius:20px;width:min(790px,95vw);max-height:min(92dvh,960px);background:#fcfdf7;color:#1c3c2f;box-shadow:0 30px 90px #091c15aa;overflow:hidden}
#v103skillMastery::backdrop{background:#10241dba}
#v103skillMastery .v103skill-top{position:sticky;top:0;background:#163d2d;color:#f5f8ef;padding:14px 22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;z-index:2}
#v103skillMastery .v103skill-top strong{font:700 21px Georgia,serif}
#v103skillMastery .v103skill-top button{background:transparent;color:#fff;border:1px solid #ffffff80;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px}
#v103skillMain{padding:clamp(17px,4vw,34px);overflow:auto;max-height:calc(92dvh - 68px)}
#v103skillMain h2{font:700 clamp(25px,4vw,39px)/1.22 Georgia,serif;color:#1a4030;margin:8px 0 14px}

</style><script id="study-theme-state">// One theme preference owns both the old reading control and the current tools control.
(function(){
 'use strict';
 const KEY='studytable:v100:theme',LEGACY='studytable_v52_night';
 const valid=value=>value==='light'||value==='dark';
 function sync(){
  const dark=document.documentElement.dataset.studyTheme==='dark';
  const portal=document.getElementById('v35Portal');
  if(portal&&portal.classList.contains('v52-night')!==dark)portal.classList.toggle('v52-night',dark);
  for(const button of document.querySelectorAll('.v52-mode,[data-study-theme-toggle]')){
   const text=dark?'Light mode':'Dark mode';if(button.textContent!==text)button.textContent=text;
   if(button.getAttribute('aria-pressed')!==String(dark))button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(dark));
  }
  const themeButton=document.getElementById('v100Theme'),text=dark?'Light mode':'Dark mode';
  if(themeButton){if(themeButton.textContent!==text)themeButton.textContent=text;themeButton.setAttribute('aria-label','Switch to '+(dark?'light':'dark')+' mode')}
  for(const proxy of document.querySelectorAll('[data-tool="v100Theme"]'))if(proxy.textContent!==text)proxy.textContent=text;
  if(document.documentElement.style.colorScheme!==(dark?'dark':'light'))document.documentElement.style.colorScheme=dark?'dark':'light';
 }
 function set(value){
  const theme=value==='dark'?'dark':'light';
  if(document.documentElement.dataset.studyTheme!==theme)document.documentElement.dataset.studyTheme=theme;
  try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,theme);localStorage.setItem(LEGACY,theme==='dark'?'1':'0')}catch{}
  sync();
 }
 let initial=null;
 try{const saved=localStorage.getItem(KEY),old=localStorage.getItem(LEGACY);if(valid(saved))initial=saved;else if(old==='1'||old==='0')initial=old==='1'?'dark':'light'}catch{}
 if(!initial)initial=window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches?'dark':'light';
 window.studyTableTheme={set,sync,get:()=>document.documentElement.dataset.studyTheme};
 set(initial);
 new MutationObserver(records=>{if(records.some(r=>r.type==='attributes'))set(document.documentElement.dataset.studyTheme);else sync()}).observe(document.documentElement,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['data-study-theme'],childList:true,subtree:true});
 window.addEventListener('storage',event=>{if(event.key===KEY&&valid(event.newValue))set(event.newValue);else if(event.key===LEGACY&&(event.newValue==='1'||event.newValue==='0'))set(event.newValue==='1'?'dark':'light')});
})();
</script><style id="st170-home-style">
